name: print-social-rich-bake-bread-loaves-on-beach-chairs-summer-ad
title: Rich Bake toast bread loaves lounging on beach chairs under an orange parasol
whatItIs: A bright composite of two bagged Rich Bake toast loaves sitting in striped deckchairs under an orange-and-white parasol on a sandy beach, with a sandcastle, seagulls, ships on the horizon and a blue sky.
whatItMeans: Cheerful and witty; personifying bread on holiday makes an everyday staple feel summery.
techniques: Match parasol colours to the pack.
Fill the scene with small beach details for charm.

vocabulary.definition: An image assembled from several photos.
Fast-moving consumer goods, everyday supermarket products.
